title: Recorded guarded /ask responses (version 1)
description: Offline observations, not golden answers. Future --live recording must use guarded POST /ask and query_log total embedding + generation cost. Each response separately validates against api/schemas.py and ask_response.schema.json. All REVIEWED question ids must be present exactly once. DRAFT modes are not scored. synthetic=true is reserved for smoke fixtures, never golden scoring. STUB inclusive bounds default to 120000 ms and GBP 1 per request, configurable via --max-latency-ms and --max-cost-gbp; not calibrated service targets or spend enforcement.
